scope: Public phone screenshot galleries in Google Play's main English listing (native artwork), plus the verified developer's iPhone App Store galleries from Israel. Tablet repetitions, icons and feature graphics excluded. Distinct platform artwork retained; no exact-byte duplicates.
notes: Source URLs, original dimensions and SHA-256 hashes below allow re-verification of mechanically compressed delivery images.
Only images larger than1,000,000bytes were converted to WebP quality92 with no cropping and maximum1320x2868 bounds; smaller store images remain byte-for-byte originals.
App Store and Google Play screenshots for SovietKino and Tanakh Quiz use different platform phone frames/compositions, so they are distinct gallery images rather than duplicates.
